status: B-side proposal; frozen only when G0 records a merge SHA in docs/spec/gate_status.json

unit_legend.tick: uint16 1..999; price = tick/1000 USDC per claim; one lot at one tick = 1 atom
unit_legend.Q: cashQ unit; 1 atom = 1e18 Q; 1 USDC = 1e24 Q; PAYOFF_Q_PER_LOT = 1000*Q
unit_legend.usdcWad: USDC scaled by 1e18 (pure-kernel money unit); convert to Q by *1e6 exactly
unit_legend.seconds: uint64 Unix seconds / durations; no milliseconds

rounding_legend.UP: result is an upper bound of the exact real value (requirements, hazards, k, sigma, adverse probability, drift, horizon)
rounding_legend.DOWN: result is a lower bound (epsilon', usable assets, payouts, TWAP prices unless stated)
rounding_legend.TRUNC0: truncate toward zero; used ONLY where the spec says so (funding rate quantization, spec §6.2)

common_unavailable_results.FULL_BACKING_REQUIRED: Any domain failure: a0+a1>=1, a_adv>=epsilon, epsilon' rounds to 0, missing/expired calibration, cap meets bounded loss. Caller must check both exact endpoints E0>=0 && E1>=0 (spec §4.2, DEC-09).
common_unavailable_results.UNAVAILABLE: Price/window/time input not valid; caller must refuse new exposure (spec §4.1). Never encoded as price 0.
common_unavailable_results.BAD_UNITS: Out-of-range input (tick outside 1..999, wad > 1e18, |lots| > 2^40, negative duration); revert in Solidity, raise in reference.

functions.name: horizonSeconds
functions.formula: h = h0 + queue + ceil(|x| * 60 / v)
functions.error: BAD_UNITS if v == 0; x == 0 returns h0 + queue (caller returns zero margin separately)
functions.domain: 0 <= |x| <= 2^40 lots; v > 0; h0, queue >= 0; result fits uint64

functions.name: sigmaTheoryUpper
functions.formula: sqrt(q(1-q) h / max(T-t, 1s)), then min(., 1)
functions.error: UNAVAILABLE if q at an endpoint (live risk requires interior price)
functions.domain: 0 < q < 1e18; h >= 0; T-t >= 0 (clamped to >= 1 s)

functions.name: empiricalEnvelopeAt

inputs.name: bins
inputs.unit: list of (hSecs, sigmaWad), strictly increasing h
inputs.domain: nondecreasing sigma required; validity interval [validFrom, validUntil]

functions.formula: value of the first bin with bin.h >= h (step-up envelope); h beyond last bin => unavailable
functions.error: FULL_BACKING_REQUIRED if bins missing, expired, not yet valid, h beyond last bin, or bins decrease (raw noisy bins rejected, spec §7.4 'Nonmonotone empirical bins'); conversion helper makeEnvelope() returns running max for calibration tooling only
functions.domain: bins nonempty, strictly increasing h, nondecreasing sigma, validFrom <= now < validUntil, h <= last bin h

functions.name: sigmaUpper
functions.formula: min(1, max(theory, realized, template))
functions.error: FULL_BACKING_REQUIRED propagates from any missing empirical input
functions.domain: all inputs in [0, 1e18] or explicitly missing

functions.name: hazardUpper
functions.formula: min(1, hazard * h / 86400)
functions.error: none; saturates at 1e18
functions.domain: hazard >= 0, h >= 0; product checked for overflow

functions.name: tailFactor
functions.formula: aAdv = a0 (long) / a1 (short); eps' = (eps - aAdv)/(1 - aAdv); k = sqrt((1-eps')/eps')
functions.rounding: aAdv UP, eps' DOWN, k UP
functions.error: FULL_BACKING_REQUIRED if a0+a1 >= 1, aAdv >= eps, or eps' rounds to 0

functions.name: adverseDrift
functions.formula: mLong = (1-q) a1 / (1-a0-a1); mShort = q a0 / (1-a0-a1)
functions.error: FULL_BACKING_REQUIRED if a0+a1 >= 1

functions.name: sideMargin

inputs.name: profile
inputs.unit: RiskProfile {h0Secs, absorptionClaimsPerMin, queueDelaySecs, hazard0WadPerDay, hazard1WadPerDay, epsilonWad, gammaWad, sWad, lambdaWadPerClaim, capX (integer leverage cap), realized/template envelopes, calibration validity}

functions.formula: w = q (long) / 1-q (short); MM = min(|x|w, |x|(m + k sigma_h + s) + 0.5 lambda x^2); IM = min(|x|w, max(gamma MM, |x| w / Lcap))
functions.error: x == 0 returns zeros and fullBackingRequired=false; any domain failure returns MM=IM=|x|w and fullBackingRequired=true; Lcap == 1 returns fullBackingRequired=true
functions.never: divides by x or by equity
functions.domain: |x| <= 2^40 lots; 0 < q < 1e18; profile complete and calibration valid, else full backing

functions.name: directionalCap

inputs.name: deploymentCapX
inputs.unit: integer leverage ceiling from manifest (initial deployment = 1)

functions.formula: min(templateCap(template, side), deploymentCapX); uncalibrated => 1
functions.error: missing calibration => 1 (never a guessed leverage)
functions.domain: template in the 4 listed values; deploymentCapX >= 1

functions.name: accountHealth
functions.rounding: EXACT for equities; margins already UP
functions.error: fullBackingRequired => HEALTHY iff E0>=0 && E1>=0 (no rounded mark comparison)
functions.domain: |cashQ| < 2^180; |n| <= 2^40 lots; 0 < q < 1e18 for mark equity; margins from sideMargin at the same q

functions.name: displayLeverage
functions.formula: floor(exposure * 1e4 / E) only when E > 0
functions.error: E <= 0 returns available=false; never used by any safety decision (ASSUMPTION B001-A3)
functions.domain: exposure >= 0; E any sign (E <= 0 => unavailable)

functions.name: markedEquityLowerBound
functions.formula: c + x mQ - Qb max(PbidMaxQ - mQ, 0) - Qa max(mQ - PaskMinQ, 0) - feeCap, mQ = 1000 qWad
functions.error: BAD_UNITS on tick/lots range
functions.domain: ticks 1..999 or the 0/1000 none-sentinels; lots within uint128 aggregate; 0 <= q <= 1e18

functions.name: imEnvelopeUpper
functions.formula: max(LongIM(max(0, x + Qb)), ShortIM(max(0, -(x - Qa))))
functions.error: fullBackingRequired if either evaluated side is full-backing
functions.domain: |x|, Qb, Qa <= 2^40 lots after the reachable-interval sum; risk inputs as sideMargin

functions.name: admitCommitments

inputs.name: coverage
inputs.unit: CoverageInput {d0Q, d1Q (A order-aware endpoint deficits), accountDeficitCapQ, marketCoverageOk}; scripted port until G1

functions.formula: fullBacking ? (d0==0 && d1==0) : eMin >= imUpper; plus max(d0,d1) <= deficitCap and marketCoverageOk
functions.rounding: EXACT comparison of UP/DOWN rounded operands
functions.error: UNAVAILABLE price => STALE_PRICE
functions.domain: inputs as markedEquityLowerBound and imEnvelopeUpper; coverage values supplied by A (scripted before G1)

functions.name: safeTakerCap
functions.formula: candidate = requested; while candidate > 0 and !admit(candidate) and steps < 64: candidate /= 2
functions.error: returns 0 with reason when no candidate passes; below minOrderLots => 0
functions.domain: 1 <= requested <= maxOrderLots (<= uint48 max at the book boundary); tick 1..999; at most 64 halvings

functions.name: twapWindow

inputs.name: samples
inputs.unit: list of (observedAt seconds, priceWad, valid bool), nondecreasing time

functions.formula: each valid sample carries forward over [t, min(next.t, t + stale, windowEnd)); twap = integral / windowSecs
functions.error: UNAVAILABLE unless coveredSecs == windowSecs; same-timestamp samples add zero weight
functions.domain: samples ordered by observedAt, windowSecs > 0, staleSecs > 0, prices in [0,1e18]

functions.name: markPrice
functions.formula: median(I + basis, perpTwap, perpLive) clamped to [I - b(t), I + b(t)] and [0,1e18]; b(t) = 0.05 max(T-t,0)/(T-listedAt)
functions.error: UNAVAILABLE if any of the three candidates or I unavailable (BOOTSTRAP path only)
functions.domain: all inputs valid wads; listedAt < T; now >= listedAt

functions.name: fundingRate
functions.formula: f = clamp(q - I, +-0.05 min(I, 1-I)) per claim per day; r = trunc0(f * 1000 * Q / 86400) = trunc0(fWad * 1000 / 86400)
functions.error: UNAVAILABLE price => no authorization (rate 0 is a real rate, not unavailable)
functions.domain: 0 <= q, I <= 1e18, both valid at epoch opening

functions.name: depthValid
functions.formula: valid iff both depths >= N, 0 < bid <= ask < 1e18, ask - bid <= maxSpread; mid = floor((bid+ask)/2)
functions.error: invalid sample contributes no coverage
functions.domain: N > 0 lots; prices in [0,1e18]

functions.name: movementTrigger
functions.formula: |now - ago| > threshold
functions.error: missing ago sample => no trigger from this rule (freshness rules still apply)
functions.domain: prices in [0,1e18]; threshold > 0

functions.name: allowedReduction

inputs.name: before/after
inputs.unit: (xLots, E0Q, E1Q, markEquityQ, mmQ) incl. fees

functions.formula: |xA|<|xB|, no sign flip, d0A<=d0B, d1A<=d1B, EA>=0, EA-MMA >= min(EB-MMB,0)
functions.error: EB <= 0 => false (use takeover branch)
functions.domain: before and after states at one frozen price, fees included; xBefore != 0

functions.name: reductionEstimate
functions.formula: g = IM-E; D = IM - s|x|; if g>0, D>0, D^2 >= 2 lambda g x^2: delta = 2 g |x| / (D + sqrt(D^2 - 2 lambda g x^2)) else full close
functions.rounding: UP to whole lots, clamp to |x|
functions.error: estimate only; caller rechecks actual margin (never asserts restored health)
functions.domain: x != 0, E > 0 (positive-equity branch only); s, lambda >= 0

functions.name: bankruptcyTick
functions.formula: long sell: t >= ceil((threshold - E + fee + n mQ)/(n Q)); short buy: t <= floor((E - fee - threshold + n mQ)/(n Q)); E = c + x mQ
functions.error: feasible=false if bound outside 1..999
functions.domain: closeLots > 0 and <= |x|; x != 0; fee >= 0

functions.name: liquidationDecision

inputs.name: health, stage, priceFresh, graceExpired, floorActive, workBudget, liquidityAvailable

functions.formula: TAKEOVER iff E<=0 (fresh) or floor endpoint deficit or both endpoints <= 0; REDUCE iff E<MM or (graceExpired and E<IM); work exhaustion with E>0 => NEEDS_MORE_WORK
functions.error: zero work budget => revert/reject (spec §5.2)
functions.domain: work budget > 0 (zero budget rejected); health from a touched account at the legal cutoff

functions.name: pairTick
functions.formula: clamp(floor(q / 1e15), 1, 999)
functions.error: none

functions.name: deriveStage
functions.formula: CLAIMS_READY > HALTED(t>=T or halted) > REDUCE_ONLY(t>=T-1h or monitor) > BACKING_FLOOR(t>=T-12h) > BACKING_GRACE(t>=T-12h30m) > TRADING; boundaries inclusive
functions.error: none
functions.domain: now, T, haltAt are uint64 seconds; T - 12h30m >= listedAt

functions.name: cutoffs

inputs.name: now, epochEnd, fundingStopAt, fundingFreshThrough, scheduledT, economicHaltAt, frozenRolloverCutoff

functions.formula: accrual = min(now, epochEnd, haltAt?, frozenRollover?); funding = min(accrual, fundingStopAt, T-12h, fundingFreshThrough)
functions.error: none; never later than any stop
functions.domain: all inputs uint64 seconds; 0 means unset for optional stops

functions.name: graceExpired
functions.formula: belowMM => true; else now >= min(anchor + graceSecs, T - 12h)
functions.error: anchor 0 (never deficient) => false
functions.domain: anchor <= now or 0; graceSecs >= 0

functions.name: invalidCaptureReadiness
functions.formula: now<T: NOT_YET; complete: CAPTURE_TWAP; incomplete & fallbackListed: now>=T+grace ? CAPTURE_FALLBACK : WAIT_GRACE; incomplete & legacy: BLOCKED
functions.error: legacy unconditional-TWAP market never uses fallback (INVALID_PRICE_BLOCKED)
functions.domain: T >= listedAt + 24h; grace = 3600 s for new listings

functions.name: acceptFinality
functions.formula: UNSET => accept; same => false; different => revert ConflictingFinalOutcome
functions.error: CONFLICTING_FINALITY
functions.domain: incoming in {NO, YES, INVALID} (UNSET rejected)

functions.name: normalPricingTransition
functions.formula: BOOTSTRAP -> NORMAL only at a completed epoch opening with all three candidates + index valid; NORMAL with missing candidate => mark unavailable (bootstrap-only admission while index valid)
functions.error: halt/stronger stage overrides any pricing mode
functions.domain: mode in {BOOTSTRAP, NORMAL_PRICING}
